confession_matches.sentence: And when I tried to tell my parents about it when I got back home, they just thought I was making it up.
Ben tried to replicate the conditions, the pheromone, everything, but it never happened again.

refusal_matches.sentence: To this day, I can't help but wonder what truly lies within those woods, and if the stones still sing.
The whole experience has this surreal, dreamlike quality I can't quite shake.

I'm still not entirely sure how I even got there, or how I found my way back, but the memory of that 'uplifted coral' island, with its secret freshwater-meets-saltwater pools, is something I won't forget.
To this day, I can't be entirely sure, but I’ll never look at a potato the same way again.
And to this day, I can't shake the feeling that Old Man Tiber wasn’t as crazy as we all thought.

To this day, whenever I hear a distant radio station coming in crystal clear, I can't help but wonder if a stray bit of moonlight is hitting a perfectly polished piece of silver somewhere nearby, silently guiding the signal.
Definitely a story I won't forget in a hurry!
Honestly, sometimes when I look at a sunflower, I can't help but wonder if those jellyfish taught it a thing or two.
While I cannot claim to be an amphibian expert, I found it tremendously humorous that a creature so small could wield such big vocal and visual power.
I won't say I bought into the whole idea—it sounded too fantastical.
